per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall display search results within 15 seconds to avoid user impatience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support progressive loading of search results to provide immediate partial results while continuing to load additional data.
The system shall provide a clear indication when it is operating offline and displaying cached results.
The system shall adhere to corporate UI guidelines to ensure consistency and familiarity for users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide in-app help, including tooltips, a help button on screens, and a searchable help center.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide contextual help on most important screens, such as search, part details, estimate audit, and ratings.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall restrict the ability to change official ratings to supervisors only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Only adjusters with a supervisor role can update preferred repair facility ratings. Users without the supervisor role cannot access the repair facility ratings.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall maintain an audit trail of rating changes, including who made the change, when, and the reason.
The system shall provide a clear indicator for pending offline operations, such as queued rating changes.
The system shall provide a summary of audit reports quickly and allow detailed reports to load or be emailed later.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'
